review_candidates.title: Infra Tech Lead
review_candidates.description: Infra Tech Lead Location: New York City, New York, USA Working model: Fully in-office, five days a week Salary: $200,000–$275,000 base + equity Experience: 6+ years (typically 6–8 years) Open positions: 2 — one infrastructure-leaning lead and one product-leaning lead About the company Join a Series B AI company transforming sales and revenue intelligence for enterprise businesses. The company builds AI-powered solutions that help sales teams work more effectively, automate workflows and gain deeper insights from customer interactions. Its platform supports more than 100 enterprise sales teams, with AI agents at the centre of its product offering. As the company continues to scale, it is building a team of senior product engineers in New York to take ownership of its core architecture, accelerate product development and deliver its next generation of AI-powered capabilities. This is an opportunity to join a collaborative, fast-moving team with direct access to the Chief Product Officer (CPO) and meaningful influence over technical strategy. The role As an Infra Tech Lead, you'll serve as a technical anchor for the engineering organisation, combining hands-on engineering with architectural ownership, technical leadership and mentoring. You'll help shape the AI agent platform that powers the company's enterprise products while taking ownership of a flagship feature from concept through delivery. Over your first six months, you'll be expected to make a tangible impact on the architecture and product. You'll mentor a team of approximately seven to eight junior engineers, helping them develop their technical skills and grow into stronger contributors, while remaining actively involved in system design, implementation and complex engineering decisions. Two profiles are being considered: an infrastructure-leaning lead focused on distributed systems and platform architecture, and a product-leaning lead who combines strong technical foundations with end-to-end product ownership. What you'll do Own and evolve the architecture of the AI agent platform supporting more than 100 enterprise sales teams. Lead the design and implementation of distributed systems and production services using Go. Take technical ownership of a flagship product feature, delivering meaningful progress within your first six months. Make architectural decisions that improve reliability, scalability, maintainability and performance. Work closely with product leadership to translate business priorities into technical solutions. Mentor seven to eight junior engineers, helping them grow into increasingly independent and senior contributors. Balance hands-on coding with technical direction, code reviews and system design. Drive infrastructure and product initiatives from initial architecture through production deployment and continued improvement. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to identify bottlenecks, improve developer workflows and raise engineering standards. Help scale the platform and engineering practices as the business grows. What we're looking for At least 6 years of software engineering experience, ideally within a B2B SaaS or enterprise product environment. A proven track record as a Tech Lead, Lead Engineer or Staff-level engineer with significant technical ownership. Strong production experience with Go (Golang). Deep knowledge of distributed systems and the ability to design, build and operate systems at scale. Experience taking infrastructure or a technical platform from initial design through production adoption and continued scaling. Evidence of making important architectural trade-offs and explaining their impact. Experience mentoring engineers and helping them develop into more senior contributors. A strong understanding of how technical architecture supports real customer and business requirements. A track record of sustained ownership and progression within an organisation. Willingness to work in the New York office five days a week. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a pure individual-contributor or engineering-management position. You'll be expected to remain close to the code while setting technical direction and helping other engineers succeed. What will make you stand out? Platform ownership: You've taken a production infrastructure platform from zero to one and scaled it to support increasing customer and business demands. Strong Go expertise: You've designed, built and operated Go services in a production environment at meaningful scale. Architectural judgement: You can describe a significant technical decision you personally made, the alternatives you considered and the outcome. Technical mentorship: You've helped engineers grow into senior contributors through coaching, code reviews and technical guidance. B2B product experience: You've built technology that directly supports enterprise customers and complex business workflows. AI and sales technology: Experience with conversational AI, CRM integrations, call analytics or AI agent platforms is a plus. Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with Temporal or similar workflow orchestration technologies is beneficial. Sustained technical ownership: You've demonstrated progression and meaningful responsibility over several years, rather than moving frequently between short-term roles. Why join? High-impact technical ownership: Shape the architecture behind an AI platform used by more than 100 enterprise sales teams. Senior engineering influence: Set technical direction while remaining hands-on with important engineering challenges. Build for scale: Solve distributed-systems and infrastructure challenges in a growing Series B AI business. Mentorship opportunities: Help develop the next generation of engineers and raise the team's technical standards. Direct access to leadership: Collaborate closely with the CPO and influence product and technical strategy. Competitive compensation: Earn $200,000–$275,000 in base salary, plus equity. Collaborative environment: Join a flat, product-focused engineering team with substantial responsibility and room to make an impact. Interview process Engineering leadership screening: Discuss your experience, technical ownership and leadership approach. Technical assessment: Demonstrate your system-design skills, hands-on coding ability and familiarity with AI development tools. VP of Engineering interview: Explore architecture, technical strategy and leadership experience. On-site interviews with engineering and product: Meet the team and discuss technical and product challenges. Final conversation with the CEO: Align on expectations, motivation and the opportunity ahead. Offer: Successful candidates receive an offer to join the team. Interested? If you're an experienced engineer who combines deep Go and distributed-systems expertise with technical leadership and a passion for building scalable B2B products, we'd like to hear from you. Apply with your CV and be prepared to discuss a system you personally architected, the trade-offs you made, the results you achieved and how you've helped other engineers develop.

review_candidates.title: Global Medical Education manager (H/F)
review_candidates.description: Envie de contribuer à faire évoluer les pratiques médicales et d'avoir un impact concret sur la prise en charge des patients à l'international ? Rejoins les Fonctions Globales d'Urgo Medical en tant que Global Medical Education manager et participe au développement de nos franchises Compression et Acute Care , au cœur des enjeux d'éducation médicale et d'innovation. A propos d’Urgo Medical Chez Urgo Medical , nous sommes convaincus que l’innovation peut transformer des vies. Notre mission : aider les patients à cicatriser plus vite et mieux, grâce à des produits de pointe et des services digitaux innovants. Certaines plaies sont graves, deviennent chroniques ou peuvent s’infecter, causant douleur et isolement . Nous relevons ce défi chaque jour , en développant des solutions qui accélèrent la cicatrisation et en menant des projets ambitieux, comme la volonté de créer la première peau artificielle au monde ! Urgo Medical, c’est aussi une entreprise unique. A la fois : française , avec 84 % de nos produits fabriqués en France ; familiale , avec une vision à long terme et un véritable esprit entrepreneurial ; internationale , avec environ 2 300 collaborateurs présents dans 17 pays ; et surtout, engagée autour d’une même mission : Healing People. Notre culture s’appuie sur trois piliers : Engaged Team, Winning Mindset et Learning Organization . Ils reflètent notre façon de travailler au quotidien : collaborer, apprendre en continu, prendre des initiatives et viser l’excellence. A propos du groupe Urgo Urgo Medical appartient au Groupe URGO , groupe familial français spécialisé dans la santé et le bien-être, à travers des marques reconnues telles qu’Urgo, Mercurochrome, Juvamine, Alvityl, Humex ou Intimy. Avec un chiffre d’affaires de 1 milliard d’euros en 2026, le Groupe URGO rassemble plus de 3 600 collaborateurs engagés autour d’une même ambition : prendre soin de la santé et du bien-être de chacun . Cet engagement se traduit également à travers sa Fondation d’entreprise , qui mène des actions d’intérêt général dans trois domaines : la cicatrisation, la gestion de la douleur et l’accès aux premiers soins. Le savais-tu ? Le fondateur du groupe, Hervé Le Lous, partage son expérience d’entrepreneur et sa vision du management sur Instagram. Une bonne façon de découvrir la culture d’entreprise URGO. Urgo Boss (@urgo_boss) • Photos et vidéos Instagram Et les Fonctions Globales dans tout ça ? Les Fonctions Globales réunissent environ 200 collaborateurs répartis sur plusieurs sites en France , aux expertises complémentaires, qui accompagnent le développement d’Urgo Medical et travaillent avec ses différentes entités. Les rejoindre, c’est collaborer avec des interlocuteurs de métiers et de pays variés, et contribuer à des projets transverses. Quel que soit ton métier, tu participes à une ambition commune : donner aux équipes les moyens de faire avancer notre mission, Healing People . Ton rôle chez Urgo Medical Ta mission ? Rattaché(e) au Responsable Relations Professionnelles, Medical Education & Training, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la conception et le déploiement de programmes d'éducation médicale à destination des professionnels de santé, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Médicales Globales et nos filiales internationales. Ton objectif ? Développer les connaissances des professionnels de santé, renforcer les collaborations avec les experts scientifiques et contribuer à l'amélioration des pratiques de soins, tout en accompagnant le développement de nos franchises à l'international. Tes principales responsabilités : 1. Contribuer à la stratégie Medical Education internationale Participer à la définition et au déploiement de la stratégie Medical Education pour les franchises Compression et Acute Care. Identifier et analyser les besoins de formation des professionnels de santé et des différents marchés. Concevoir et piloter des initiatives d'éducation médicale en lien avec les priorités scientifiques, médicales et stratégiques des franchises. Construire et suivre les feuilles de route des programmes Medical Education, en coordination avec les équipes globales et locales. Évaluer l'impact des initiatives déployées et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration. 2. Développer et animer un réseau international d'experts Identifier, engager et développer des relations durables avec les experts médicaux et scientifiques internationaux (KOLs). Organiser et animer des advisory boards, groupes de travail et réunions d'experts. Recueillir les retours et expertises des professionnels de santé afin d'enrichir les programmes d'éducation médicale et d'accompagner l'innovation. Développer des collaborations avec les sociétés savantes, associations professionnelles et associations de patients. Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique d'Urgo Medical à travers des initiatives et partenariats à forte valeur ajoutée. 3. Concevoir des programmes de formation innovants et engageants Imaginer, développer et déployer des programmes de formation adaptés aux besoins des professionnels de santé : modules digitaux, ateliers pratiques, webinars, formations présentielles et parcours pédagogiques. Transformer des données scientifiques et cliniques complexes en contenus pédagogiques clairs, accessibles et engageants. Explorer les nouvelles technologies, les outils digitaux et l'intelligence artificielle pour enrichir les expériences de formation. Accompagner les lancements de nouveaux produits et les évolutions des gammes à travers des initiatives éducatives ciblées. Garantir la qualité scientifique et la cohérence des contenus éducatifs déployés à l'international, en collaboration avec les équipes médicales. 4. Contribuer à l'évolution des pratiques cliniques Développer des initiatives de sensibilisation autour de la compression veineuse et de la prise en charge des plaies aiguës. Participer au déploiement de campagnes de sensibilisation et d'éducation thérapeutique, telles que Legs Go ou Save Feet Save Life , en fonction de leur périmètre. Contribuer à la diffusion des connaissances scientifiques, des données cliniques et des recommandations de bonnes pratiques. Accompagner les professionnels de santé dans une meilleure compréhension des pathologies et des solutions de prise en charge. Participer à des projets visant à améliorer les pratiques de soins et les bénéfices pour les patients. 5. Collaborer avec les équipes internationales et représenter Urgo Medical Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Médicales, Communication et les filiales internationales pour assurer la cohérence et le déploiement des initiatives. Accompagner les équipes locales dans l'adaptation des programmes Medical Education aux spécificités de leurs marchés. Participer à l'organisation et à l'animation de congrès internationaux, symposiums, workshops et événements scientifiques. Partager ton expertise auprès des équipes internes et contribuer à leur montée en compétences sur les franchises Compression et Acute Care. 🎓 Ton profil Formation supérieure scientifique (Pharmacie, Sciences de la vie, École d’Ingénieurs ou équivalent), complétée ou non par une spécialisation en Marketing ou en Management de la Santé. Première expérience réussie de 3 à 5 ans dans les domaines de la Medical Education, des affaires médicales, du marketing santé ou du développement de programmes scientifiques, idéalement dans l'industrie des dispositifs médicaux ou de la santé. Anglais courant , à l’écrit comme à l’oral, dans un environnement international. Forte appétence pour les nouvelles technologies, le digital et l’intelligence artificielle , et leur utilisation au service de l’éducation médicale et de l’engagement des professionnels de santé. 🌟 Pour trouver ta place chez Urgo Medical Au-delà de ton parcours, c'est aussi ta personnalité qui fera la différence ! Tu as un excellent relationnel : tu aimes créer du lien, fédérer des interlocuteurs variés et construire des relations de confiance durables. Tu es organisé(e) et autonome : tu sais piloter plusieurs projets simultanément, définir tes priorités et faire avancer tes sujets avec rigueur. Tu es curieux(se) et créatif(ve) : tu aimes explorer de nouvelles idées, proposer des approches innovantes et transformer les besoins en solutions concrètes. Tu apprécies le travail en équipe : tu sais évoluer dans un environnement international et transverse, en favorisant la collaboration. Tu fais preuve d'agilité et d'assertivité : tu sais écouter, convaincre, t'adapter à différents interlocuteurs et prendre des initiatives. Tu es animé(e) par l'impact de tes actions : contribuer à l'amélioration des connaissances des professionnels de santé et, à terme, de la prise en charge des patients donne du sens à ton travail. 🚀 Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un environnement stimulant, entrepreneurial et international . Des responsabilités concrètes et la possibilité d’avoir un impact réel . Une culture qui encourage l’initiative, la collaboration et l’apprentissage . L’opportunité de contribuer à des projets ambitieux au service de la santé des patients . Envie de relever le défi avec nous ? Rejoins l’aventure Urgo Medical ! URGO est attaché à la mixité et à la diversité . Nous recrutons et reconnaissons tous les talents.

By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE, and JACK WOLFSKIN etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. What you'll do As the General Manager for the Europe Region, you will have full P&L ownership of the regional business, driving sales growth, profitability, and market expansion across retail, wholesale, and online channels. You will develop and execute the regional strategic plan, build a high-performing local organization, and ensure full compliance with EU regulations while delivering sustainable, long-term growth. In this role, you will: Deliver annual business objectives set by headquarters, including sales targets, gross margin, profitability, inventory management, and business development. Develop strategic plans to ensure healthy business operations, achieve high return on investment, and build a long-term, sustainable growth trajectory. Manage daily business operations and foster a work culture aligned with organizational objectives. Drive business development across retail, wholesale, and online channels to achieve regional targets. Build and continuously improve full-function business infrastructure across Marketing, Retail Merchandising, Sales & Operations, Finance, Human Resources, and IT. Communicate and align business goals with internal stakeholders and external partners. Conduct business forecasting and data analysis; prepare and submit operational reports to regional and China headquarters as required. Develop, empower, and motivate department heads to achieve team-level targets and goals. Evaluate operational and financial performance; drive continuous improvement initiatives. Manage company budget and take full ownership of P&L. Provide regional team with regular market trend analysis and competitive intelligence. Undertake other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by Management from time to time. Coordinate and facilitate clear communication between local department heads and the regional team. What you'll bring Leadership, decisiveness, analytical, and strong interpersonal skills Visioning, aligning, and prioritization abilities Creative problem solving, strategic planning, business planning, and decision-making skills Passionate about sports is a must Fluent in English is required. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related field; MBA is a plus. 8–10 years of experience in a general manager or equivalent leadership capacity. Ability to communicate professionally in Mandarin Chinese is preferred to communicate with counterparts based in China HQ. Travel This role requires frequent business travel across the Europe region to support local market operations and business expansion. Occasional travel to global headquarters may also be required. Equal Opportunity Employer We are an equal opportunity employer. review_candidates.title: Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Data)
review_candidates.description: Full-Stack Engineer (Product & Data) Location: San Francisco, California, USA Working model: Fully in-person, 9 AM–5 PM Salary: $130,000–$180,000 base + 0.6–0.7% equity Experience: 0–5 years Visa sponsorship: Available Open positions: 2 About the company Join a fast-growing, seed-stage fintech building technology that helps families access and manage education funding in the United States. The platform gives parents access to education funds while helping states distribute funding more efficiently and detect potential fraud. With the product already live and growing rapidly, the company is expanding its platform to support more families, states and federal programs. The team combines former founders and experienced fintech professionals, creating an environment where engineers have significant autonomy and the opportunity to make a direct impact on the product from day one. The role As a Full-Stack Engineer focused on Product & Data, you'll build the mobile and web experiences that parents use to manage their education funds. You'll work on features such as receipts, claims, reimbursements and financial statements, making complex processes simple and intuitive for non-technical users. The key challenge isn't getting users to spend more time in the app. It's helping them accomplish what they need as quickly and effortlessly as possible. You'll work across the full stack, combining strong data-modeling skills with product thinking, thoughtful UX decisions and fast execution. This is an opportunity for someone who loves building useful things, takes ownership naturally and wants to see their work make a tangible difference. A university degree isn't required if you can demonstrate exceptional ability through shipped products, personal projects or other meaningful achievements. What you'll do Build and improve the parent-facing mobile and web applications. Develop features for receipts, claims, reimbursements, statements and other financial workflows. Design data models that support accurate financial information, intuitive user experiences and increasing usage. Make thoughtful product and UX decisions that reduce friction for parents. Work across frontend, backend and data layers to deliver complete features. Ship improvements frequently, test ideas and iterate based on real user needs. Take ownership of projects from concept and architecture through implementation and production. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and make the product more useful. Collaborate closely with the founding team and product stakeholders in a fast-moving environment. What we're looking for A builder's mindset and the ability to turn ideas into working products. Full-stack or mobile engineering experience, including hands-on work with technologies such as React, React Native or comparable frameworks. Strong data-modeling skills and the ability to design systems that remain reliable as usage grows. A genuine interest in product development, usability and UX. Evidence of shipping products or projects, ideally with real users. The ability to work autonomously, make sound technical decisions and deliver quickly. Curiosity, initiative and a willingness to take ownership beyond a narrowly defined role. A genuine interest in the company's mission and the problems it is solving. Willingness to work from the San Francisco office five days a week. Your track record matters more than your degree or years of experience. Strong personal projects, a successful early business, competition wins, fellowships or impressive open-source contributions can all demonstrate the qualities the team is looking for. What will make you stand out? Shipped products: Mobile apps, web applications or side projects with real users. Links to your work are strongly encouraged. Strong data-modeling judgment: Examples of data models you've designed, the trade-offs you made and how they performed as usage grew. A track record of building: Personal projects, hackathon wins, startup experience or products you created simply because you wanted them to exist. Exceptional initiative: Experience through entrepreneurial ventures, fellowships or other achievements that demonstrate autonomy and ambition. Relevant fellowships: Experience with programs such as Neo, Contrary, Z Fellows, Pear Garage or South Park Commons. A personal connection to education: An interest in improving access to education funding is a plus. Why join? Real product ownership: Take responsibility for features used by parents managing education funds. Build from the ground up: Influence product decisions, architecture and the user experience rather than simply maintaining existing systems. Autonomy from day one: Bring your ideas to life and ship improvements without unnecessary layers of process. Meaningful impact: Help families access and manage education funding more easily. Competitive compensation: Earn $130,000–$180,000 in base salary, plus 0.6–0.7% equity. Visa sponsorship: Available for eligible candidates. No degree requirement: Demonstrated ability and exceptional work can outweigh formal qualifications. Interview process Founder introduction: Discuss your background, motivation and interest in the company's mission. Technical deep dive: Explore your engineering skills, product judgment and approach to data modeling. Optional conversation with the Head of Parent Experience: Discuss user needs and the parent-facing product. Take-home assignment and whiteboard presentation: Demonstrate your technical ability and reasoning. Paid on-site work trial: Work on real projects with the team. Offer: Successful candidates receive an offer to join the company. Interested? If you're a hands-on engineer who loves building products, cares about user experience and can demonstrate what you've created, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and links to your apps, GitHub, portfolio or personal projects. Be prepared to explain what you built, the data-modeling decisions you made and how you approached the user experience.
